lines.text: Paul sends Tychicus and Onesimus to tell the Colossians all the news and to encourage their hearts.
Aristarchus, Paul's fellow prisoner, and Mark, cousin of Timothy, send greetings, and the Colossians should welcome Mark if he comes.
Epaphras, one of the Colossians, wrestles in prayer for them and goes to great pains for Laodicea and Hierapolis.
Luke the physician and Demas send greetings, and Paul tells them to greet the church at Lydia's house.
Paul wants his letter read in Laodicea, tells Archippus to complete his ministry, and writes the greeting in his own hand.
